text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A centipede at that. My data says their
bite is
poisonous, so I shall proceed with
termination
protocol.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Do not worry. I will deal with this in
the most
efficient manner possible.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I... Um... I appreciate the thought,
but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Can't we just take Mr. Centipede
outside? Pretty
please?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I see no reason to argue. But are you
not
frightened, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I am scared, but... I'm sure Mr.
Centipede is
even more scared than me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eek! M-Mr. Centipede, please... just...
stay there,
okay?!
